title: hamamelis japonica var. megalophylla
intro: Hamamelis japonica var. megalophylla, commonly known as Japanese witch hazel, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan and Korea. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese witch hazel include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation, and its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful for treating skin conditions and injuries. The bioactive constituents of Japanese witch hazel include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
